summary: [SDLC Chat] Review-all-files loop: model re-read same targets with varying offset/limit — 162 calls before guard abort

rootCause.analysis: Old TurnBudgetGuard keyed repeats on IDENTICAL tool+args. Re-reading the same file with different offset/limit evaded the identical-args signature (162 calls). Transcript compaction also dropped tool activity silently, so the model lost track of what it had already read and re-read.
fix: turn-budget-guard.ts: read-class tools keyed on exploration TARGET (file path) — reread of same target trips regardless of arg variation (final scope: read/ls — grep/find patterns with same target can be legit scoped rescans); reread steer correction pushes synthesis, never more exploration; text-block perseveration guard
pi-provider.ts: wire reread/identical steer + text-block observation + guard-stop intentional-abort mapping (K2)
transcript-compaction.ts: dropped-tool-activity tombstone note at trim boundary so the model knows what was already read

implementation.note: 6 files (guard + provider + compaction + 3 test files). Fix found in-progress in working tree from parallel session; verified + committed + deployed by SM-agent session.
